crossRefs.note: A certain man of the sons of the prophets said to his fellow by Yahweh’s word, “Please strike me!” The man refused to…
In the time of his distress, he trespassed yet more against Yahweh, this same king Ahaz.
“After all that has come on us for our evil deeds, and for our great guilt, since you, our God, have punished us less…
shall we again break your commandments, and join ourselves with the peoples that do these abominations? Wouldn’t you be…
Yet the people have not turned to him who struck them, neither have they sought Yahweh of Armies.
O Yahweh, don’t your eyes look on truth? You have stricken them, but they were not grieved. You have consumed them, but…
In a little while, the sky grew black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.
Their border was to Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem,
Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east assembled themselves together; and they passed…
Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek; and the Israelites encamped by the spring which is in…
Yahweh said to him, “Call his name Jezreel; for yet a little while, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel on the house…
It will happen in that day that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel.”

people.name: Ahab
people.line: Wicked king of Israel; husband of Jezebel

people.name: Jezreel
people.line: A city in Issachar, associated with Ahab and Jezebel

people.name: Naboth
people.line: Jezreelite vineyard owner, unjustly killed by Ahab and Jezebel.

people.name: Samaria
people.line: Capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel; Samaritan inhabitants

translations.web: After these things, Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard, which was in Jezreel, next to the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.
translations.bsb: Some time after these events, Naboth the Jezreelite owned a vineyard in Jezreel next to the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard, which was in Jezreel, hard by the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.
translations.asv: And it came to pass after these things, that Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard, which was in Jezreel, hard by the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.
